Ready to take on a dynamic role where creativity fuels pipeline? We’re looking for a Business Development Representative (BDR ) in the EMEA region who will be responsible for generating new qualified opportunities through proactive outbound prospecting for their Account Executive partners.

If you’re passionate about finding new ways to spark conversations, thrive on owning your number, and love the challenge of building outbound pipeline — we want to hear from you.

Use tools like LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Lusha, Vidyard, Vidu, Aircall, and HubSpot CRM to research accounts and drive outbound engagement.
Enroll outbound leads in prospecting campaigns and follow up consistently across multiple channels.
Maintain consistent outbound activity focused on cold, net-new pipeline creation.
Keep HubSpot contact, company, and deal records clean and up to date with detailed activity notes.
Accept and work leads assigned by members of the sales, revenue, and marketing organizations.
Make process and tooling suggestions that improve outbound effectiveness.
Own your 1:1s by preparing in advance, sharing updates, and taking action on coaching feedback.

Sales associates are supported by the Specialist role with mentoring, guidance, and training. Sales associates are expected to work with, learn from and request guidance from Specialists in addition to their supervisors.

Sales associates utilize and complete tasks with basic retail equipment including, but not limited to, cash registers, time clocks, RF scanners, mobile printers, handheld equipment (i.e., Price labeling units, box cutters), signage equipment and basic fixture equipment such as, but not limited to peg hooks, shelves, and mobile stocking carts (5S Program).

About Wayflyer
Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer.
Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan.
You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney.
The challenge
We've deployed over $6bn to small businesses that traditional banks were too slow, too rigid, or too disinterested to back. Now we're growing fast, and we need a world-class sales team to continue the momentum, finding the founders who need us before they know we exist.
What you'll actually do
You'll be the first voice a lot of founders ever hear from Wayflyer. That matters. Your job is to cut through the noise - smart outreach, real conversations, and get the right businesses in front of our Account Executives. You'll qualify funding needs, build genuine rapport with founders, and figure out pretty quickly that the best reps here aren't order-takers. They're curious, they hustle, and they care about getting it right.
What this role could turn into
We'll be honest -this isn't a role we're hiring you to stay in forever. It's a launchpad. Most BDRs move into Account Executive or Customer Success roles within 12–18 months, and we plan for it actively through our Revenue Academy - a structured programme that builds the skills, deal exposure, and commercial fluency you need before you ever step into your next seat. Your manager isn't just hitting you with pipeline reviews; they're invested in where you want to go and what it takes to get there.
We're building careers here, not just filling headcount. The people who thrive with us are the ones who are hungry to grow - and we take it as our responsibility to make sure the path is there when they are.
Who thrives here
You've worked in a target-driven environment before and you didn't just survive it, you wanted more. You're the kind of person who reads a rejection email and immediately thinks about what to try differently. You spot problems outside your lane and you can't help yourself. You'll probably end up doing things that aren't in this job description. That's not a warning, it's the point.
We hire for range
We care more about trajectory than tenure. Relevant sales experience is important, but what we're really looking for beyond that is someone who's hungry, commercially sharp, and genuinely excited by the challenge. Fluent English is a must. Startup experience is a bonus, not a requirement.
Location and working policy
📍 Sydney, hybrid (3-4 days per week in the office)
The good stuff
25 days off, plus public holidays. Private healthcare, life insurance, and pension. Equity - because you should own a piece of what you're building. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want.

About Concurrence
At Concurrence, we're building the clinical AI infrastructure that health systems, life sciences companies, payors, and government agencies run their patient-facing care on. Our agents work across the whole patient journey: pre-visit intake, care navigation, post-visit care plans, and ongoing monitoring. Our mission is to make excellent care accessible to every patient, not rationed by the limits of clinician time.
This hasn’t been solved because the underlying record was never built for it. EHRs were designed for billing, not for systems that learn. So instead of layering another point solution on top, we’re rebuilding the medical record as a timeline of clinical events and running agents on top of it that improve with every patient interaction.

Unlike single-purpose chatbots or scribes, Concurrence is the platform our customers use to build their own agents. That means our work has to hold up across specialties, workflows, and regulatory environments and not just one narrow use case.
Our agents have supported more than 10 million patient encounters and are on track to grow tenfold this year. Our work is validated through partnerships with leading academic medical institutions. We’re fresh off our Series A, backed by Tier 1 VCs such as Madrona, General Catalyst, and Optum Ventures.
We’re a small team of around 35 people, working in person in New York City and San Francisco. We care deeply about craft, clinical rigor, and the speed at which good ideas reach patients. If you want your work to be measured in outcomes rather than releases, we’d like to hear from you.

Our Core Values
Patients Win, We Win
If patients aren't getting better care, we haven't earned the right to scale. Every internal decision gets pressure-tested: does this make patients' lives better? If we can't draw the line, we question why we're doing it.
High Standards, High Care
We hold a high bar for the team because patients are counting on us to get this right. But high standards only work with genuine investment in each other. You can take risks, admit mistakes, and challenge ideas—not despite our standards, but because of them.
Thoughtful Urgency
We move fast by default, but speed without judgment is recklessness. The discipline is knowing which decisions are reversible vs. not. In healthcare AI, the companies that win will be fast everywhere they can be and careful everywhere they must be. We build the muscle to do both.
Intensely Measured
We instrument patient outcomes, provider ROI, system performance, and clinical accuracy. But data without action is surveillance. Every metric should have an owner, a threshold, and a response plan. If we're measuring something but never acting on it, we stop measuring it.
Who Builds With Us
Low ego: Politics and territory don't interest you. The best ideas win, regardless of who has them.
Direct: You say the hard thing, challenge ideas openly, and commit fully once decided.
High agency: You thrive on trust rather than instruction. When you see something is broken, you fix it. You don’t file tickets and wait for someone else.
Bar of excellence: You hold yourself to a bar most people wouldn't, and you want teammates who do the same.
Skeptical: You push back on rules that don’t make sense and question assumptions that haven’t earned their place.

Category-defining tech. Career-defining work.
For more than a decade, Cockroach Labs has built database technology trusted to power some of the world's most mission-critical applications. Now, as AI transforms how software is created and operated, the infrastructure behind it has to keep pace. Cockroach Continuum is built to meet this moment, bringing individual databases together into one fleet designed for agentic applications, where AI agents help teams provision, scale, and optimize workloads at machine speed.
The customers you’ll work with are some of the most innovative businesses in the world, and the problems they’re trying to solve are real and urgent. You’ll bring a genuinely differentiated product to a market moving fast, at a company positioned to lead it. The people who thrive here are the ones who want to own that opportunity.

Cockroach Labs is seeking Sales Development Representatives to serve as the engine of our top-of-funnel growth across our North American regions. In this role, you’ll focus on creating and nurturing new enterprise opportunities - identifying the right accounts and buyers, generating qualified meetings, and building early engagement that can develop into pipeline.
Working in regionally aligned pods alongside Account Executives, you’ll co-execute signal-driven account strategies, and run targeted, multi-channel outbound plays across your book. Your focus is to hunt for new opportunities, nurture buyer interest, and create the quality conversations that move accounts forward.
If you thrive in fast-paced GTM environments, embrace AI-powered prospecting, and love opening doors with enterprise buyers, we want to hear from you.
To be eligible for this role, you must be based in Austin, TX and will be expected to go into the office on Mondays, Tuesdays & Thursdays.
You Will
Drive top-of-funnel growth by identifying, prioritizing, and engaging target accounts and personas
Use AI-powered prospecting, intent signals, and engagement data to personalize and scale outreach
Hunt for new opportunities and nurture buyer engagement across phone, email, LinkedIn, events, and other channels
Generate qualified meetings by uncovering relevant business problems and use cases for Cockroach Continuum
Partner closely with AEs in regionally aligned pods to prioritize accounts and coordinate outreach
Build strong knowledge of Cockroach Continuum, the database industry, and our customers’ use cases
Consistently meet and exceed qualified meeting targets while maintaining a high bar for quality
The Expectations
In your first 30 days, you will learn about Cockroach Continuum and become proficient in the product. We believe that it is necessary for you to build this foundation so you can successfully grasp Cockroach Labs' sales strategy. Upon completion of your first month, you will have the ability to manage and develop inbound leads effectively.
After 60 days, you'll manage inbound leads and create campaigns for continued engagement. After 90 days, you will be generating qualified pipeline for the sales team and hitting or exceeding your targets.
You Have
6 months to 1 year of previous Lead Generation or Sales Development experience.
Experience collaborating and developing positive business relationships.
Worked with deadlines, effectively managing time and prioritizing tasks.
Gathered and used data to inform and persuade others.
Developed compelling strategies that meet targets.
Experience with CRM-related tools (i.e. Salesforce.com) and lead qualification-related applications.
Excellent interpersonal, leadership, organizational, and communication skills.
BA/BS degree or equivalent in related field.

From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you.
We’re looking for a Field Sales Executive to join our Dublin team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you’ll help us build relationships with new restaurant partners across the region, improving our proposition for customers and identifying ways to continue our fast growth.
Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.
What You’ll Be Doing
You’ll be joining the Regional UK and Ireland team. The Regional UK and Ireland team drives Deliveroo's performance across local markets, focusing on signing the best restaurant selection and expanding our footprint within the region.

s.h: Here’s what your day-to-day might look like
s.t:
Drive regional restaurant acquisition: Map, prospect, pitch, and close high-value restaurant partners across Greater Dublin and surrounding regions to expand our local market selection.
Execute strategic business development: Engage with independent restaurants via physical visits, emails, calls, and social platforms to demonstrate the commercial value of Deliveroo’s technology.
Own the commercial onboarding journey: Oversee the end-to-end partner onboarding process to ensure it is fast, efficient, and seamless for new partners.
Secure early partner success: Actively support and monitor new restaurant performance within their first eight weeks on the platform to maximise their long-term growth.
Act as a local territory expert: Build deep insight into the regional food scene, travelling across Greater Dublin and areas like Kildare, Portlaoise, and Drogheda to identify key brands that local customers crave.

Proven new business acquisition: Demonstrated sales experience with a track record of actively targeting new business, hunting out hidden gems, and delivering against demanding targets.

Effective communication: Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills across face-to-face, telephone, and written channels.
Autonomy and field-based resilience: A self-motivated, tenacious approach with the ability to work independently and spend significant time out on the road meeting prospects.

Großer Markt, perfektes Timing: Deine Verantwortung
Der deutsche Gesundheitsmarkt befindet sich an einem entscheidenden Wendepunkt. Als Account Executive (x/f/m) im Vertriebsgebiet Dreieck Leverkusen, Wuppertal und Gummersbach (rechtsrheinisch) führst Du Dein Territory wie ein eigenes Business und bringst mit unserer KI-gestützten All-in-One-Lösung echten Mehrwert direkt in den Praxisalltag.
Du gewinnst neue Zahnarztpraxen für Doctolib und begleitest sie auf dem Weg zu einer effizienteren, digitaleren Organisation. Die Chance, die vor uns liegt, ist noch weit größer als das, was wir bisher aufgebaut haben.
Deine Aufgaben
Outbound und Inbound Sales: Du kombinierst die aktive Ansprache potenzieller Kund:innen über bereitgestellte Leads, telefonisch und vor Ort, mit der Bearbeitung eingehender Inbound-Anfragen. Dein Ziel ist es, qualifizierte Ersttermine zu vereinbaren und neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten zu entwickeln.
Erste Verkaufsgespräche und Bedarfsermittlung: Du führst erste Gespräche mit Zahnärzt:innen und Praxisteams, verstehst ihre Herausforderungen und identifizierst ihren individuellen Bedarf.
Full-Cycle-Sales: Du verantwortest den gesamten Sales Cycle, von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme über die Bedarfsermittlung, Produktpräsentation und Verhandlung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss.
Pipeline, Umsatz und Wachstum: Du baust Deine Pipeline eigenständig auf und verantwortest die Entwicklung Deines Vertriebsgebiets.
Kundenzentrierte Beratung: Du zeigst potenziellen Kund:innen den konkreten Mehrwert unserer digitalen HealthTech-Lösung für ihren Praxisalltag.
Datengetriebene Erfolgsmessung: Du trackst Deine Performance regelmäßig mit Salesforce und nutzt Daten für eine gezielte Vertriebsstrategie.
Strukturierte Übergabe nach Vertragsabschluss: Nach dem Abschluss übergibst Du Deine neuen Kund:innen strukturiert an unser Projektmanagement-Team. Dort werden sie anschließend vollständig betreut und bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung begleitet.
Die Position ist vollständig auf die Gewinnung neuer Kund:innen ausgerichtet. Eine laufende Bestandskundenbetreuung gehört nicht zu Deinen Aufgaben.
Dein Profil
Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die oder der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen.
Sales ist Deine Welt: Du hast mindestens zwei bis drei Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, idealerweise im Außendienst und im Neukundengeschäft
Proaktivität und Akquise-Talent: Du hast bereits eigenständig Pipeline aufgebaut und neue Kund:innen gewonnen
Beratungsstärke: Du kannst erklärungsbedürftige Produkte oder Dienstleistungen verständlich und kundenzentriert vermitteln
Energie und Überzeugungskraft: Du trittst sicher und professionell auf, verkaufst mit Leidenschaft und lässt Dich auch von Rückschlägen nicht entmutigen
Entrepreneurial Mindset: Du bist ergebnisorientiert, gut organisiert und behältst auch bei Herausforderungen den Fokus
Kommunikation auf Top-Niveau: Du kannst Dich sehr gut mündlich und schriftlich auf Deutsch auf C1-Niveau oder höher ausdrücken
Internationale Kompetenz: Für interne Trainings, All-Hands und die Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Kolleg:innen sind Englischkenntnisse hilfreich, aber keine Voraussetzung
Regionale Verfügbarkeit: Dein Vertriebsgebiet umfasst das Dreieck Leverkusen, Wuppertal und Gummersbach (rechtsrheinisch). Du bist bereit, regelmäßig Kundentermine in dieser Region wahrzunehmen. Ein Wohnort in der Region oder in erreichbarer Nähe ist hilfreich, aber keine zwingende Voraussetzung
Flexibilität und Mobilität: Dein Vertriebsalltag findet dort statt, wo es zählt, direkt bei Zahnärzt:innen vor Ort. Ein Führerschein der Klasse B wird vorausgesetzt
Erfahrung im SaaS-, HealthTech- oder Healthcare-Vertrieb ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Entscheidend sind Deine Erfahrung im B2B-Neukundenvertrieb, Deine Eigenständigkeit und Dein Wille, Dinge voranzutreiben.

At Flipdish, we’re turning the tables in favour of independent restaurant and takeaway owners by offering them powerful, simple-to-use tech solutions backed by real human support. Everything we do is designed to make running a restaurant satisfyingly simple in a world that’s anything but.

You’ll join the Sales team as a Territory Sales Executive, owning new business growth across your territory. You’ll manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting and first outreach through discovery, proposals, negotiation, and close.
This is a field-based, commercially focused role for someone who can build a strong pipeline, run compelling face-to-face meetings, and connect Flipdish’s value to the commercial and operational goals of restaurant and takeaway owners. Success in this role looks like consistently hitting new business targets, closing good-fit customers, and building a well-forecasted pipeline with clear next steps.
What you’ll own
Own the full sales cycle for your territory, from prospecting and first outreach through discovery, proposals, negotiation, and close.
Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities, balancing warm inbound leads with proactive outbound prospecting.
Run compelling face-to-face meetings and tailored demos that clearly link Flipdish’s value to each customer’s commercial and operational goals.
Listen, diagnose, and advise: uncover pain points, build a consultative business case, and recommend the right solution and commercial structure.
Navigate complex deals with multiple stakeholders, handle objections, and move opportunities forward with pace and professionalism.
Challenge poor decisions and propose better ways of working. Constructive challenge is a responsibility: prioritising harmony over truth or progress is a failure of responsibility.
What success looks like
Consistently hit or exceed monthly and quarterly new business targets for your territory.
Maintain a high-quality, well-forecasted pipeline with clear next steps and strong conversion through each stage.
Close deals that are a good fit and onboard smoothly, with low churn risk and clear customer outcomes.

s.h: You’ll thrive in this role if you
s.t:
Have experience in sales or business development, ideally in field sales or territory management.
Can demonstrate a proven ability to build your own outbound pipeline and consistently hit or exceed targets.
Are confident running consultative conversations: asking the right questions, listening well, and connecting product value to business outcomes.
Are highly organised and self-directed: you can plan your territory, manage your time, and follow up without needing constant direction.
Are commercially savvy and comfortable discussing pricing, ROI, and contract terms.
The following would help you stand out.
Restaurant experience or restaurant tech experience selling SaaS to SMB restaurants.
Strong negotiation skills and evidence of closing mid-market or multi-site opportunities.
Familiarity with POS, online ordering, loyalty, or restaurant operations tooling.
What you get
We’re a growing startup and we understand that amazing incentives will attract amazing talent. Alongside a competitive salary, we offer unparalleled opportunities for career growth. If you’re smart, ambitious, and hard-working, we’ll do whatever it takes to make you a Flipdisher!
Time off: 25 days annual leave + public holidays + company days (e.g. Summer Fridays , seasonal)
Private healthcare: UK cover (incl. Vitality private health insurance)
Pension: retirement savings support (UK)
Equity (ESOP): share options, so you can share in Flipdish’s long-term success
Team connection: regular team meet-ups and company events

s.h: Here’s what you can expect throughout the interview process.
s.t:
Recruiter screening call (15 minutes)
Hiring manager interview (60 minutes)
Hiring manager interview (30 minutes)
Role-play Interview (60 minutes)
Reference checks

At Flipdish, we’re on the side of independent restaurant and takeaway owners, running busy operations on tight margins with rising costs, staffing challenges, and an increasingly demanding customer base. Our job is to make their lives easier with technology that’s powerful, satisfyingly simple, and backed by real human support.
Our integrated ecosystem, spanning online ordering, marketing, loyalty, point of sale, menu optimisation, and operational automation, helps restaurants grow while staying in control. We’re an AI-first company, and we use it to help our customers get better outcomes, faster ordering, smarter marketing, and smoother operations, so owners and teams can spend more time on what matters.
Inside the company, we value ownership and clarity, with a friendly, people-led culture behind it. We trust our people to help shape what kind of employer Flipdish is, not just follow a script. Transparency is huge for us: we listen to each other, collaborate, and create the space for people to grow (with balance, not burnout).

We care about diversity, inclusion, and wellbeing as standard, and we encourage flexibility where it works. We’re focused on impact and team energy, not “being seen”. You’ll have meaningful scope, work closely with smart people across teams, and be trusted to make things better as Flipdish scales.
If you’d like to read more about interviewing at Flipdish, please check out our Interviewing at Flipdish guide.

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.

Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions.

Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital.

Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X .
We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will focus on three core missions. One, you will help our users and prospects navigate their Grafana journey by engaging with and listening to them in order to provide them with appropriate resources and guidance.

Two, with these learnings, you will partner with our Sales Team to connect with other influential people in these organizations to identify new business opportunities that are the pipeline for our company’s revenue goals by partnering proactively with our Sales Team.

And three, you will develop valuable, transferable skills to help you achieve your career goals. By fulfilling our three core missions, you will contribute importantly to Grafana Labs’ community and business goals.
We understand that our commercial success is linked to our open source DNA and users’ success with our software. As such, we want team members who can effectively leverage this connection and help support the long-term health of our company.
In this role, you will balance reactive and proactive work, responding to inbound inquiries as well as outreaching to target accounts. You will need to research and have a detective mindset in order to craft thoughtful, value-add messaging; and you’ll need to be confident driving business conversations on the phone. You will need to know how to use AI as a tool to constantly improve your productivity.
This is a demanding and rewarding role. It is a fast-paced and challenging environment. While our company is growing sustainably, we still have a lot of building and improving to do. And we do this work together with our teammates from more than 15 different countries.

We're looking for driven, humble, technically curious people who embrace a team-first attitude and demonstrate extreme ownership. This is a great team to join, whether you’re just starting your career or looking to pivot into the tech industry.

You’ll have managers and teammates that care deeply about you as a professional and human, and you will learn more than you thought possible.

Build and maintain knowledge of our technology, competitors, open source ecosystem, and industry trends
Follow up on inbound leads effectively and efficiently
Use a multi-channel approach (email, social, calling) to proactively outreach to new leads within target accounts; our top SDRs are confident and effective on the phone
Use Salesforce and Grafana dashboards for lead and account management and research
Use research and data to prioritize and customize outreach to target prospects and accounts via email and LinkedIn
Drive effective discovery conversations to understand users’ needs and goals in to provide them the appropriate resources and communicate how Grafana can help them
Consistently meet new business opportunity and pipeline targets
Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as marketing and sales to win as a team

Located in France

Let’s be honest - interviewing is not easy. However, we want you to come prepared and succeed. When we interview, we’re trying to determine a couple of things:
Would you be successful if you were part of our team?
Will you love working here and be a positive influence on your fellow colleagues?
Will you grow professionally and personally during your time here?
We’re looking for people who are curious and passionate about technology, so make sure you invest some time in learning about Grafana Labs. Explore our community, the industry we operate in, what we offer, and how we set ourselves apart.
During your interview, you’ll be sharing stories about your current and past roles and experiences. The best way to frame this is with the CARR model: Context, Action, Results, Reflection. This allows you to succinctly share the experiences you’ve gained.
Remember, humility drives learning and we love working with people who are always trying to better themselves. Throughout our interview process, you will receive feedback, and usually directly in the interview. As you move through the interview process, make sure you listen to the feedback you receive and figure out how to incorporate the advice in the next step of the interview.

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.
You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.
If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:
North American hotel operators are running on legacy, on-premise technology that creates system fragmentation and manual workarounds across everything they do. This BDR role exists to continue to expand the East Coast and Central US market for Mews, building qualified pipeline from the first cold call to the booked discovery meeting.
You will work across the East Coast territory, owning outbound prospecting to hotel GMs, revenue managers, and group procurement contacts. The pipeline you build is the commercial foundation for everything Mews does in the East Coast and Central US.
What you would do
Run multi-channel cold outreach including calls, emails, and targeted sequences to hotel GMs, revenue managers, and procurement contacts, converting conversations into booked discovery meetings for the Account Executive team
Research and tier new business opportunities in the East Coast and Central US market, building pipeline on your own initiative
Track and report pipeline activity to your direct manager on weekly, monthly, and quarterly cadences
Feed market intelligence from hotel operators back to your regional commercial team to sharpen targeting and outreach approach
Utilize AI often to do research and prospecting
What you would bring
Ideally at least six months of experience in an outbound-facing role where you initiated contact and handled rejection, whether BDR, SDR, inside sales, or a high-contact customer-facing position
Living and located on the Central to East Coast, USA OR Central USA (TX, TN, etc.)
Hospitality experience strongly encouraged but not required
A genuine connection and passion to hospitality, through hotel operations, front desk, reservations, events, food and beverage, or deep curiosity about how hotels work, so you can speak credibly to a GM from the first call
Clear written and verbal communication in both languages, with the ability to adapt your tone for different decision-maker profiles
AI Fluency Level 2 or the equivalent hands-on experience: deliberate use of AI for outreach research and drafting, consistent review before anything goes out, and full ownership of the result
AI Fluency Level 2: In practice, this means using AI to draft and personalise outreach to hotel GMs, giving it real context about the property, the GM's known situation, and the tone that works with hospitality operators, then reviewing and editing before anything is sent. You are actively experimenting with AI sequencing tools and research assistants and building a view on what produces better results with North American prospects. Every message that reaches a prospect is yours.
For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to "AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates" on Confluence.

Familiarity with Salesforce and outbound platforms such as Outreach, Salesloft, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator
Prior BDR or SDR experience at a SaaS company with a track record of hitting activity and pipeline targets
Hospitality experience
SaaS experience

Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems.

It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works.

Results that matter.
Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.
As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of experience in outbound B2B enterprise software sales (e.g., BDR or Inside Sales), specifically prospecting into large enterprise accounts.
Hands-on experience conducting technical discovery with technical stakeholders (e.g., Data Engineers, Enterprise Architects, CTOs) and translating infrastructure concepts into business value.
Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding quarterly pipeline generation targets (e.g., booking 8+ qualified Enterprise Sales Qualified Opportunities per month).
Direct experience executing outbound prospecting campaigns targeting India and broader APAC sub-regions (e.g., Southeast Asia).
Proficiency with enterprise sales technology stacks (e.g., Salesforce, Outreach, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).
Ability to work in a hybrid model based in Bangalore (1–2 days/week in-office), with the flexibility to cover APAC time zones, travel as required, and start within 60 days.

Direct sales or prospecting experience within data infrastructure, analytics, AI, graph databases, or information management sectors.
Proven ability to map complex enterprise accounts and engage both technical leaders (CTOs, Data Architects) and business unit executives (Risk, Compliance, Fraud).
Skilled at leveraging intent data, market news, and tech-stack insights to craft highly targeted, high-impact value propositions.
Capability to lead structured, value-based discovery conversations to surface core business challenges and build compelling business cases.
High resilience, self-starter mindset, and a proven track record of consistently exceeding outbound KPIs in high-growth, competitive environments.

As an Outbound Business Development Representative (BDR) at Neo4j, you will serve as the strategic spearhead driving our market expansion. Partnering directly with Enterprise Account Executives, you will systematically map, penetrate, and qualify high-value opportunities within priority accounts—proactively hunting for greenfield pipeline and building the foundational relationships that fuel our growth.
In this role, you will blend targeted outreach, deep account research, and structured qualification frameworks. You will turn cold prospects into high-value technical and business conversations by articulating how graph technology solves complex enterprise data challenges.

About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Working closely with Partner Development Managers and Stripe Account Executives, you will drive growth in new users and revenue across your portfolio. You will help Stripe and its partners establish joint value propositions, identify shared account opportunities, and move opportunities through the deal cycle.

This is a foundational role on a high-performing sales team, and it's designed to be the start of a real career, not just a first job. You'll be on the front lines building the pipeline that fuels our growth — and you'll be developed deliberately from day one through the Flex Sales Onboarding & Enablement, not just thrown into the deep end.
Where you'll work: This role is hybrid out of our Salt Lake City office (Lehi, UT), and you'll be in with the team 3 days a week. We're big believers that some of the best coaching, energy, and deals happen in person (and honestly, the team is pretty fun to be around). As a bonus, you'll get a Grubhub credit for lunch on the days you're in the office.
Where you'll travel: Beyond SLC, you'll get out of the office for company offsites in Mexico and our Sales Kickoff in Florida as well as onboarding in NYC , both built for big wins, big energy, and time to connect with the team outside the day to day grind.

Win new client relationships, driving revenue and market share across the rental real estate space.
Manage a robust pipeline in our CRM, keeping it sharp and up to date.
Tailor creative prospecting approaches for different personas across each business you target.
Establish relationships with senior executives and decision-makers through smart, persistent outbound efforts.
Follow up quickly and efficiently on every inbound lead you receive.
Educate prospective customers on how Flex helps property management companies offer their residents real financial flexibility.
Collaborate with our Accounts team to shape strategic adoption plans for new customers.
Take initiative, jumping into ad-hoc projects across the sales org.
You Could Be a Great Fit If
You're a self-starter who's genuinely hungry for success.
You have excellent written and verbal communication skills — you know how to make someone want to keep talking to you.
You build relationships with middle management and ownership quickly and authentically.
You move fast, stay flexible, and don't need everything mapped out to get started.
You thrive both working independently and collaborating with a team.
How We Set You Up
A structured first 90 days — foundational training, tool ramp, and your first certifications, building toward your first real production.
Hands-on certifications, not just training modules — you'll prove you can actually do the work, evaluated against a clear, consistent standard every SDR is held to.
An assigned AE mentor and a manager who coaches you weekly, not just at review time.
Ongoing enablement long after ramp ends — monthly development themes, team-wide visibility into what's working, and campaigns focused on where the market is moving.
A real, defined path forward — promotion to SDR II is earned through clear, objective criteria, and from there, real tracks into Account Executive or Account Management roles.
Why Flex
Strong onboarding, built to set you up for real success — we invest in ramping you right, not just throwing you into the deep end
Revenue enablement that never stops — ongoing coaching and resources designed to sharpen your skills long after ramp is over
Mentorship, built in — you'll learn directly from peers and senior sales folks who want to see you win, not just hit your own number
A real career path — this is a role to grow in , not just grow out of
A team that's winning — you'll be surrounded by top performers who are closing deals and hitting numbers, with the energy and momentum that comes from being part of a team that's actually putting up results

Life at Flex
We understand that it takes a diverse team of highly intelligent, curious, determined, empathetic, and self aware people to grow a successful company. Our HQ is located in New York City, but we have employees located throughout the US, Australia, Canada and South America.

We are growing quickly, but deliberately, with a focus on building an inclusive culture. Our dynamic team has incredible perspectives to share, just as we know you do, and we take great pride in being an equal opportunity workplace.
Offices

Ebury Shenzhen - Office Based
*Exceptional on target earnings potential*
The partnerships division in Ebury is specialist on institutional, financial brokers and FinTech sales, providing white-labelled solutions for banks, asset & wealth management firms, Money Services Businesses, Software Platforms, and other industry verticals that have a need for FX payments. We have the capability to give access to liquidity into over 130 currencies, outsourced compliance facilities and state of the art foreign exchange management software.
The Partnerships & Indirect Sales team is a crucial contributor to the growth and success and is responsible for building great relations with financial intermediaries and strategic partners.
You will develop a network of intermediaries from scratch, through market research and cold calling, with the goal to leverage maximum revenue potential. By understanding their client’s needs and presenting appropriate solutions, you will help grow our partners’ businesses whilst also achieving personal and monetary goals for yourself.
With the understanding of the market you acquire, you will become an expert within the FX world and will be set up for a successful sales career in a global Fintech.

Enjoy building new relationships with a client acquisition (“hunter”) mindset.
Interested in the financial markets, ideally with a financial background.
Excellent communication and social skills: face to face, via telephone and email. You have to enjoy talking to other people with a genuine interest to learn about them and their business.
3-5 years’ experience of sales or client facing experience in a B2B sales position.
Experienced in selling to clients operating in industries that have a need for cross-border payments.
Structured approach to conduct market research, planning and organisation skills
Passion for creatively solving problems and an entrepreneurial spirit: you are pragmatic, autonomous and self-driven.
Demonstrated ability to understand and assess new opportunities based on customer and market need, economics, technological capabilities and competitive environment.
Business fluent in English, Cantonese and Mandarin.
Able to demonstrate a strong commercial understanding of the Foreign Exchange industry with ability to network and build relationship with new clients.
Are outgoing, sociable and enjoy attending networking and social events to meet new people.

The opportunity to develop a deep relationship both with partners and end clients (CEOs, CFOs and Treasurers).
Learning and understanding business models in detail across many industries.
Industry leading basic salary and the opportunity to quickly increase your earnings through a transparent commission scheme.
Rapid career progression and a range of structured career paths including leadership, account management/dealing.
Training and mentoring from some of the world’s most experienced and successful FX leaders.
Identify and generate new business opportunities to fuel up-market growth. Lead demand generation and campaigns from conception, planning, execution, and launch.
Engage in all steps of the Sales Cycle to ensure smooth Pipeline Progression to maximise results.
Onboard new partners and clients to drive revenue and meet individual and business revenue targets.
Earn monthly uncapped commission and quarterly incentives from the revenue generated from the clients you onboard.

Up to two years of experience in sales, business development, account management, customer service, FMCG, retail, market research, or another relevant area.
